title: Abbas Abbas Abbas
body:
Abbas , Abbas , Abbas
Beta Hay Tu Ali Ka, Zahra Ki Tu Dua Hay
Shabbir Tera Aaqa, Ummul Baneen Maa Hay
Her Sorat O Chalan May Haider Say Na Juda Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Taa Hashar Tujh Say Qaim Duniya May Bas Wafa Hay
Dil Ki Muraden Ghazi Tere Alam Say Paayen
Roti Hui Jo Maaen Tere Alam Pay Aayen
Zahra Kay Dard E Pahlu Ka Deti Hay Wasta
<<DIVIDER>>
Fizza Ki Kaneezi May Inka Bhi Naam Aye
Tere Alam Ko Thaamey Her Shaks Kah Raha Hay
Mazloom E Karbala Ka Zainab Ka Wasta Hay
Pardesi Koi Aesa Pardes May Na Ujhrey
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadqay May Uskey Jiska Ghar Bhaar Lut Gaya Hay
Haey, Taqdeer Kay Sataey Tere Dar Pey Sir Jhukayen
Ashkon Ki Elteja Hum Ghazi Tujhe Sunayen
Bemaar Sarba'an Kay Zakhmo Ka Wasta Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Jitney Bhi Khasta Dil Hain Maula Shifaa Wo Payen
Her Laash Per Ali Ko Kerty Thay Yaad Sarwer Lekin Uthaney Aye Jis Waqkt Laash E Akber
Haey, Baba Ki Be-Kasi Per Rota Tha Nu-Jawan Bhi
Shabbir Nay Kaha Ju Barchi Pey Haath Rakh Ker
<<DIVIDER>>
Haey Abbas, Khanjer Galay Pey Jis Dam Bhai Kay Chal Raha Tha'
70 Qadam Say Manzer Zainab Nay Khud Yeh Dekha
Haey, Jab Shimmr Maarta Tha Gardan Pey Sheh Kay Khanjer
Her Zarb Per Tarap Ker Kehti Thi Bint E Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Haey, Sarwar Ki Laadli Ka Ik Tu Hi Tha Sahara
Paani Kisi Say Us Ney Maanga Nahi Dobara
Haey Jab Koi Marta Tha Rukhsaar Per Tamachay
Baba Say Bhi Ziyada Us Ney Tujhe Pukara
<<DIVIDER>>
Haey Abbas
Us Waqkt Jab Key Zainab Darbar May Gae Thi
Qaari Namaziyun Say Mehfil Saji Hui Thi
Haey Zaalim Yeh Pochta Ghazi Tera Kahan Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Balo'on Say Mu Chupaye Zainab Yeh Keh Rahi Thi
Shaam E Ghariban May Jis Ka Kurta Jal Gaya Hay
Kaano Say Baaliya'n Bhi Haey Shimmr Lay Gaya Hay
Is Be-Kasi Say Maula Bachi Koi Na Tarsey
<<DIVIDER>>
Farsh E Aza Pey Ro Kar Her Dil Yeh Kah Raha Hay
Jitney Bhi Ashk Maula Kirtaas Per Giray Hain
Masooma Ki Kasam Yeh Ghazi Faqat Tere Hain
Wo Kuch Raqam Karon Main Ju Na Raqam Hua Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Alfaaz Wo Ataa Kar Yawar Say Ju Parhe Hain
